name: B10-0424/2026 – After recital S – Am 28
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: Sa. whereas some third countries are leveraging religious actors, associations and segments of their diaspora to interfere with domestic political debates within the EU; whereas Türkiye has provided extensive support to the Muslim Brotherhood, ranging from hosting exiled members of the organisation to the creation of media networks close to the movement; whereas, to this day, Türkiye continues to host the annual conference of the Council of European Muslims, an organisation affiliated to the Muslim Brotherhood; whereas the Turkish Presidency of Religious Affairs (Diyanet) maintains structural links with the Turkish-Islamic Union for Religious Affairs in Germany;
